recipes.oracle_text:
This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
{1}{B}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: All other creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn.

recipe_coverage: Explicit fixed entry counters or bloodthirst component, pinned to complete Oracle passive text and numeric stats. Direct +1/+1 counter inspection, real casting/payment, both players, damage-versus-life-loss and recipient/turn distinctions, multiple damage events, combat damage, late stack responses, countered casts, blink/bounce/re-entry, cleanup, source removal, anthems versus counters, populated zones and snapshot replay after AI backups. Printed activated abilities and source keywords remain gaps. Graft, modular, other passive/triggered clauses, variable entry amounts and nonstandard costs are excluded. Not whole-card certification.
